en: A colorized historical postcard depicting a bustling market square surrounded by ornate Dutch-style buildings with stepped and ornate gables. A tall tower with a decorative spire rises behind the square. Numerous stalls, carts, and people fill the foreground, suggesting an open-air market day. The caption on the upper left reads 'NIJMEGEN. Markt'. Additional commercial signage is visible on one of the buildings.
